# Mission Galaxy

> Mission Galaxy — a colony-management simulation on a hostile alien frontier. Coming 2027.

A game in development. Coming 1 January 2027.

You run a small human settlement on a hostile frontier.

An independent game development of Advisors Group International Inc and Town4 Media Group.
